gaps.lead: You can only get a seat if you book well in advance.
gaps.explanation: if you don't book = without booking.

gaps.lead: He didn't study, so he failed the exam.
gaps.sentence: If he had studied, he ___ the exam.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.

gaps.lead: He had just got home when the power cut happened.
gaps.sentence: ___ home when the power cut happened.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: As I get older, I become less patient.
gaps.sentence: The older I get, ___ I become.
gaps.explanation: The older…, the more… — doubled comparatives for parallel change.

gaps.lead: She cooked a huge meal, but we had already eaten.
gaps.explanation: needn't have + participle = it happened although it wasn't necessary.
